records.segregation: SCN5A-D1275N in all 3 living affected and 5 unaffected relatives; deceased affected an obligate carrier; 8 relatives homozygous for both Cx40 polymorphisms, 3 affected; the 3 living patients exclusively coinherited both
quotes: One deceased and three living relatives were unambiguously affected by AS.

Candidate gene screening revealed a novel mutation in the cardiac sodium channel gene SCN5A (D1275N) in all three affected living relatives and in five unaffected relatives, and the deceased relative was an obligate carrier.
The three living AS patients exclusively coinherited both the rare Cx40 genotype and the SCN5A-D1275N mutation.

records.segregation: SCN5A L212P inherited from father in normal sinus rhythm; Cx40 polymorphisms inherited from asymptomatic mother; father lacks Cx40 polymorphisms
quotes: The novel SCN5A mutation L212P was identified in the proband (age 11 years) and his father. The father was in normal sinus rhythm. The proband had no P waves on surface ECG, and his right atrium could not be captured by pacing.
Further screenings for genetic variations that might mitigate L212P dysfunction revealed that the proband, but not his father, carries Cx40 polymorphisms inherited from his asymptomatic mother.
records.genotype_reason: single heterozygous variant; mode as stated for the family

notes.statement: Makita et al. (2005) found that the recombinant L212P SCN5A sodium channel showed a large hyperpolarizing shift in the voltage dependence of both activation (WT -48.1 mV vs L212P -63.5 mV) and inactivation (WT -86.6 mV vs L212P -95.6 mV), and delayed recovery from inactivation.
quotes: The recombinant L212P Na channel showed a large hyperpolarizing shift in both the voltage dependence of activation (WT: -48.1 +/- 0.9 mV; L212P: -63.5 +/- 1.5 mV; P < .001) and inactivation (WT: -86.6 +/- 0.9 mV; L212P: -95.6 +/- 0.8 mV; P < .001) and delayed recovery from inactivation.

notes.statement: Makita et al. (2005) concluded that genetic defects in SCN5A most likely underlie atrial standstill and that coinheritance of connexin-40 (Cx40) polymorphisms is a possible genetic factor modifying the clinical manifestation, which may explain incomplete penetrance.
quotes: These results suggest that genetic defects in SCN5A most likely underlie atrial standstill. Coinheritance of Cx40 polymorphisms is a possible genetic factor that modifies the clinical manifestation of this inherited arrhythmia.

notes.statement: Fazelifar et al. (2005) noted that atrial standstill is an extremely uncommon arrhythmia that rarely appears familial, and that it has been associated with congenital heart disease, valvular heart disease, conduction disturbances, Brugada syndrome, myocardial infarction, and amyloidosis.
quotes: Atrial standstill is an extremely uncommon arrhythmia that rarely appears to be familial and genetically determined.

Atrial standstill has been associated with several conditions including, but not restricted to, congenital heart disease, valvular heart disease, conduction disturbances, Brugada syndrome, myocardial infarction, and amyloidosis.

notes.statement: Groenewegen et al. (2003) found that in a large family with atrial standstill, the 3 living affected members coinherited the SCN5A D1275N mutation and homozygosity for 2 closely linked Cx40 regulatory polymorphisms (-44G-A and +71A-G). They proposed that, although the functional effect of each genetic change is relatively benign, their combined effect eventually progresses to total atrial standstill.
quotes: The three living AS patients exclusively coinherited both the rare Cx40 genotype and the SCN5A-D1275N mutation.
We propose that, although the functional effect of each genetic change is relatively benign, the combined effect of genetic changes eventually progresses to total AS.

notes.statement: Groenewegen et al. (2003) found that SCN5A-D1275N channels showed a small depolarizing shift in activation compared with wildtype channels, and that the rare Cx40 genotype caused reduced reporter gene expression compared with the more common Cx40 genotype.
quotes: SCN5A-D1275N channels showed a small depolarizing shift in activation compared with wild-type channels.
Rare Cx40 genotype reporter gene analysis showed a reduction in reporter gene expression compared with the more common Cx40 genotype.

notes.statement: Groenewegen et al. (2003) found homozygosity for both Cx40 polymorphisms in only about 7% of control subjects.
quotes: Eight relatives were homozygous for both polymorphisms, which occurred in only approximately 7% of control subjects
